title: AgentKit: Empowering Rapid Development of High-Quality Agent Apps

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: introducing agent kit an Innovative Lang chain-based starter kit developed by BCG ex designed to revolutionize the creation of agent apps with agent kit developers can unleash their creativity and rapidly build highquality agent applications with ease agent kit empowers developers to quickly experiment with constrained agent architectures all while enjoying a visually stunning user interface with agent kit building a full stack chat-based Agent app has never been easier from concept to production grade MVP agent kit provides the tools and framework needed for seamless development and scalability from Rapid development to flexible UI ux designed specifically for agents agent kit offers unparalleled reliability and scalability for real life use cases agent kit boasts a modular and easy to configure Tech stack based on Fast API next JS along with a library of useful geni tools agent kit is not just about building apps it's about building apps that can scale with ready-made Q management off caching and monitoring agent kit is set up to scale to MVP effortlessly
